Five repeated corruption cases reject without head revision or mtime changes; cache and observed state remain unchanged.
Independent malformed SQL event controls retain normalization, duplicate-record, digest, envelope, receipt and schema-4 origin rejection.
Public outbox validation retains nested defensive detachment.
recipe: Schema 3; accepted prepare_history seven-record seed; thirty unique scoped trusted ingests; three unchanged recalls; one peer ingest; one changed recall; twenty-five fully verified snapshot reads under cProfile. Complete executable source is m6-validation-profile.py.

reproduction.baseline_setup: Export base_commit with git archive into a disposable directory; pass that directory as --source-root. The script itself is taken from this reviewed correction.
reproduction.environment: Use the project test environment. Set OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. Script removes DML_ test settings from its own process before profile construction.
reproduction.preservation: Output uses exclusive creation. Existing captures cannot be overwritten. Temporary synthetic authority state is created and deleted by the script.

scope: Single-client synthetic validation-cost diagnosis only. Timings are observations on this local environment, not capacity or latency qualification, correctness proof, CI attestation, or milestone acceptance.
